label: Branched menu
desc: A menu button whose actions grow out of the trigger along a branching line; arrows, Home/End, type-ahead, Enter/Space and Escape all work.
use: Toolbars and row actions: put it where a kebab/more-actions menu would go.

label: Call chip
desc: A compact pill that places a call: ringing pulses, a live timer once connected, mute and hang-up buttons, then an ended summary.
use: Contact cards, support widgets and team directories.

label: Code slots
desc: A one-time-code field of separate slots: characters roll into place, focus advances, Backspace steps back and pasted codes spread across the slots.

label: Comet dial
desc: A round slider with a glowing comet head whose tail stretches as it moves; drag the ring or use the keyboard.
use: Settings panels: volume, brightness, intensity and other bounded values.

label: Dodge field
desc: A cloud of toggle chips that slip out of the pointer's way and spring back, while staying plain accessible toggle buttons.
use: Topic or interest pickers in onboarding and preference screens.

label: Flip card
desc: A card that turns over to reveal a second face on click, Enter or Space, with an instant swap under reduced motion.
use: Feature highlights, glossary items and before/after reveals.

label: Flying button
desc: A send button whose paper plane takes off with a trail while work runs, then lands as a check; async-aware and announced to screen readers.
use: Contact forms, invites and any submit that completes asynchronously.

label: Folder float
desc: A gently bobbing folder that opens its flap and floats its files up into a fan you can pick from.
use: Project and file pickers, document hubs and empty states.

label: Fuse button
desc: A press-and-hold confirm button with a burning fuse; releasing early snuffs it out, with a press-twice fallback for reduced motion and assistive tech.
use: Destructive or irreversible actions: launch, delete, publish.

label: Glide select
desc: A custom listbox select whose highlight glides between options; full keyboard support, type-ahead and form-field output.
use: Settings forms and filters that want a friendlier dropdown.
